title: Replace rather than amend the 2018 law
decision: The review will produce a new General Local Law rather than a further amendment to the 2018 law.
rationale: The 2018 law still runs on Local Government Act 1989 definitions, Part 4 is already a hole, and a fourth amendment layer would be unreadable for officers and the public.

title: Commencement target set at 19 June 2028
decision: Plan to a commencement date one month clear of the 19 July 2028 sunset.
rationale: Preserves a month of recovery time for a gazettal or administrative delay without touching the making decision.

title: Pilots close by 30 June 2027
decision: Every pilot must report by gate G4. Pilots that cannot report by then will not be started.
rationale: Drafting instructions are approved in September 2027. Evidence after that date cannot change the draft.

title: Charter of Human Rights assessment starts in phase 1
decision: Bring the Charter compatibility assessment forward to run alongside the clause triage rather than after drafting.
rationale: An assessment done after drafting cannot influence the drafting. Clauses 143, 120, 149 and 177 need the analysis before the instructions are written.

title: Treatment of the three incorporated documents
decision: Pending — whether the Footpath Trading and Keeping of Animals policies stay incorporated under cl.19 or move into the law itself.
rationale: Incorporation keeps the documents amendable without remaking the law, but weakens enforceability and leaves obligations outside the instrument people read.
